title: Ulic Qel-Droma
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: "Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon," one of the TALES OF THE JEDI from Dark Horse Comics, is depicted in a cover painting by Dave Dorman (front). The story extends the STAR WARS universe by returning to a time 4000 years before the birth of Luke Skywalker, an age when Jedi Knights were numerous and strong. Ulic quickly learns there is more than brute force to being a Jedi.
